versions.changelog:
- Parser bug fixes
- Taxonomy & spec changes
- Expanded [00_SECTION_AI_Readme] block
- Added RECOMMENDED READING section
- Cross-referenced published FigJam Community template: https://www.figma.com/community/file/1661156551667594442
- Corrected misleading "parser outputs Notion/Jira backlog" claims. Parser produces Markdown + JSON only. Notion/Jira/Linear are downstream conversions the user does themselves (manually or via MCP). Added explicit value statement: "no information loss, with legend, following industry best practices (Patton, Cohn, Lean UX)"

- Added new executive summary reference: references/figjam-executive-summary.md
- No other changes to logic or workflow; all skill functionality remains the same

- Updated sticky note syntax in documentation: uses "Acceptance Criteria:" label (was "AC:") and expanded supported role tags to include `@QA`.
- Documentation review: Minor improvements for clarity and consistency in examples and syntax descriptions.

Initial release of figjam-storymap-llm.

- Parses FigJam User Story Maps (Jeff Patton methodology) into LLM-readable Markdown or JSON via the Figma REST API, preserving spatial semantics.
- Provides both audit (LLM-readiness PASS/FAIL with fix recommendations) and parse modes.
- Supports direct input from live FigJam boards or saved Figma JSON files; no OCR required.
- Maintains activity/task/story hierarchy, release slicing (V1/V2/V3), acceptance criteria, owners, and connector relationships.
- Designed for integration with PM tools (Notion, Linear, Jira) or for use as context with coding agents.
- Enforces methodology compliance with a quality checklist and automated structure verification.
